title: BIOLAND-Cy
long_title: Bioarchaeology and Integrated Observation for LANdscape Dynamics in Cyprus
description: BIOLAND-Cy links satellite Earth Observation with published bioarchaeological evidence to reconstruct how people lived, ate and moved across ancient Cyprus. An open-science project of the ERATOSTHENES Centre of Excellence, co-funded by the European Union.
hero_lead: BIOLAND-Cy links satellite Earth Observation with already-published evidence from human and animal bones, plants and isotopes, to understand how people lived, ate and moved across the ancient Cypriot landscape. No new excavation. No new sampling. Open science from open evidence.
address: ERATOSTHENES Centre of Excellence, Limassol, Cyprus
newsletter_text: News from the project about every six months: datasets, maps, papers and events. Unsubscribe at any time.
footer_text: Bioarchaeology and Integrated Observation for LANdscape Dynamics in Cyprus. A research project of the ERATOSTHENES Centre of Excellence, Limassol, Cyprus.
funding_en: BIOLAND-Cy (EXCELLENCE/0925/0163) is implemented under the programme of social cohesion “THALIA 2021–2027”, co-funded by the European Union, through the Research and Innovation Foundation.
funding_el: Το έργο υλοποιείται στο πλαίσιο του Προγράμματος Πολιτικής Συνοχής «ΘΑλΕΙΑ 2021-2027» με τη συγχρηματοδότηση της ΕΕ.
